ops.name: agent.settings
ops.description: Lists an agent's settings for jobs.

ops.name: config.get
ops.description: Describes every setting (type, default, allowed values, host or device, whether it runs code) and returns the values in effect.

ops.name: config.set
ops.description: Changes settings by key, all or none, keeping config.toml's comments. Refused while config.toml has a mistake.

ops.name: conversations
ops.description: Lists earlier Claude and Antigravity conversations that can be resumed.

ops.name: event
ops.description: Delivers an agent's hook event from `acmd hook`.

ops.name: folders.list
ops.description: Lists a folder's subfolders here, and with files its Markdown and text files.

ops.name: folders.mkdir
ops.description: Makes a folder here.

ops.name: folders.recent
ops.description: Lists the folders of recent sessions here.

ops.name: group.archive
ops.description: Archives a group and its sessions.

ops.name: group.collapse
ops.description: Collapses or expands a group, or every group.

ops.name: group.color
ops.description: Sets a group's color.

ops.name: group.create
ops.description: Creates a group, with a name and a color.

ops.name: group.delete
ops.description: Deletes a group. Its sessions move to the Default group.

ops.name: group.move
ops.description: Moves a group to just after or just before another one.

ops.name: group.rename
ops.description: Renames a group.

ops.name: group.unarchive
ops.description: Unarchives a group, and optionally its sessions.

ops.name: harnesses
ops.description: Lists what new sessions can run here, each with an icon key, and the default.

ops.name: health.dismiss
ops.description: Stops showing a warning to one client.

ops.name: health.restore
ops.description: Shows a client every warning it dismissed again.

ops.name: hello
ops.description: Exchanges protocol and binary versions. Sent first on every connection, in both directions.

ops.name: inbox
ops.description: Lists Inbox items, newest first: one session's, or everyone's.

ops.name: inbox.answer
ops.description: Answers an Inbox item by typing into its session.

ops.name: inbox.dismiss
ops.description: Takes Inbox items out of the queue.

ops.name: inbox.read
ops.description: Marks Inbox items read or unread.

ops.name: init
ops.description: Sets acmd up as acmd init does: the agents' hooks, the settings, and the login shell's environment.

ops.name: job.check
ops.description: Checks a job without saving it: its schedule in words and its next runs.

ops.name: job.delete
ops.description: Deletes a scheduled job.

ops.name: job.pause
ops.description: Pauses or resumes a scheduled job.

ops.name: job.prompt.read
ops.description: Reads a job's own prompt file, by job id, or a draft's Markdown or text file.

ops.name: job.prompt.write
ops.description: Writes a job's own prompt file, by job id, or a draft's Markdown or text file.

ops.name: job.run
ops.description: Runs a scheduled job now.

ops.name: job.runs
ops.description: Lists a job's runs, newest first.

ops.name: job.save
ops.description: Adds or edits a scheduled job.

ops.name: layout
ops.description: Returns a client's saved pane layout.

ops.name: layout.set
ops.description: Saves a client's pane layout.

ops.name: new
ops.description: Starts a session in the background, in a folder, with a harness.

ops.name: ping
ops.description: Checks that the daemon is alive.

ops.name: remote.approve
ops.description: Authorizes a pending request's client.

ops.name: remote.authorize
ops.description: Authorizes a client by its fingerprint, or by its cert file.

ops.name: remote.browse
ops.description: Lists a host's Remote sessions, and which are added here.

ops.name: remote.call
ops.description: Runs one of a host's ops on it, as acmd --host does. The host decides which ops a paired device may run: not admin ones, nor ones for its own machine only.

ops.name: remote.cert
ops.description: Uses a cert and key of your own for a role, once they're checked to belong together, or acmd's identity again.

ops.name: remote.clients
ops.description: Lists the authorized clients and their connections.

ops.name: remote.config.get
ops.description: Returns a host's settings: its host ones, not its device ones.

ops.name: remote.config.set
ops.description: Changes a host's settings, all or none. Its device settings can't be changed from here.

ops.name: remote.deny
ops.description: Drops a pending request.

ops.name: remote.disconnect
ops.description: Drops a client's connections, or one connection.

ops.name: remote.folders.list
ops.description: Lists a folder on a host.

ops.name: remote.folders.mkdir
ops.description: Makes a folder on a host.

ops.name: remote.folders.recent
ops.description: Lists a host's recent folders.

ops.name: remote.harnesses
ops.description: Lists the harnesses a host can start.

ops.name: remote.hosting
ops.description: Turns Hosting on or off.

ops.name: remote.hosts
ops.description: Lists the known hosts and their connections.

ops.name: remote.hosts.add
ops.description: Adds a known host.

ops.name: remote.hosts.edit
ops.description: Changes a known host.

ops.name: remote.hosts.remove
ops.description: Forgets a known host, and the sessions added from it here.

ops.name: remote.hosts.retry
ops.description: Connects to a known host now, without waiting out the backoff.

ops.name: remote.identity
ops.description: Returns this machine's identity: as a host, and as a client when that's another one.

ops.name: remote.identity.regenerate
ops.description: Makes a new identity and uses it. Every peer that trusts this machine must trust the new fingerprint.

ops.name: remote.new
ops.description: Starts a session on a host and adds it here.

ops.name: remote.reload
ops.description: Reads config.toml again now, and applies the Hosting settings.

ops.name: remote.rename
ops.description: Renames an authorized client. It stays authorized and connected.

ops.name: remote.requests
ops.description: Lists requests from unknown clients waiting for approval.

ops.name: remote.revoke
ops.description: Un-authorizes a client and drops its connections.

ops.name: remote.sessions.add
ops.description: Adds a host's session here.

ops.name: remote.sessions.remove
ops.description: Removes a session added from a host. The session on the host isn't touched.

ops.name: remote.status
ops.description: Returns Hosting's state: whether it's on, where it listens, and why not.

ops.name: report.details
ops.description: Returns what a report adds about the host: its version, OS, and for a bug the end of its log, cleaned of secrets.

ops.name: report.page
ops.description: Makes the GitHub page for a report from its title and body, cleaned of secrets.

ops.name: resume
ops.description: Resumes a paused background session.

ops.name: session.archive
ops.description: Archives sessions, stopping their agents.

ops.name: session.describe
ops.description: Sets a session's description.

ops.name: session.finish
ops.description: Stops a session's agent and marks it finished.

ops.name: session.move
ops.description: Moves sessions to a group.

ops.name: session.purge
ops.description: Deletes archived sessions for good, with their conversations.

ops.name: session.remote
ops.description: Turns sessions' Remote switch on or off: whether clients of Hosting may see and use them.

ops.name: session.remove_added
ops.description: Forgets sessions added from a host, here only: the host keeps them.

ops.name: session.rename
ops.description: Renames sessions: the name for one, numbered ("api - 1", "api - 2") for several.

ops.name: session.screen
ops.description: Returns a session's screen and recent history as plain text: all of it, or its last lines. Sessions on this machine only, for now.

ops.name: session.seen
ops.description: Marks a session as seen: you've looked at it.

ops.name: session.unarchive
ops.description: Unarchives sessions.

ops.name: set.add
ops.description: Adds a session to a set, after one of its members or at the end. It moves to the set's group.

ops.name: set.create
ops.description: Makes a set of sessions, in order. They move to the first one's group.

ops.name: set.end
ops.description: Ends a set. Its sessions stay where they are, on their own.

ops.name: set.remove
ops.description: Takes a session out of its set. The set ends if one session is left.

ops.name: shutdown
ops.description: Asks the daemon to exit, so a newer acmd can replace one left over from before an upgrade.

ops.name: snapshot
ops.description: Returns the sessions, groups, view state, notices, Inbox, jobs, wake state, Remote state, settings, health, features and updates. A client id says which warnings it dismissed.

ops.name: speech.install
ops.description: Sets speech up for the voice, in the background.

ops.name: speech.say
ops.description: Reads text aloud, and answers when it's done or stopped.

ops.name: speech.status
ops.description: Says how speech stands here: there, on, set up, setting up, speaking.

ops.name: speech.stop
ops.description: Stops reading aloud, whatever started it.

ops.name: status
ops.description: Returns counts of sessions and connections, for doctor and tests.

ops.name: view.archived
ops.description: Shows or hides archived sessions.

ops.name: view.filter
ops.description: Sets the text filter.

ops.name: view.focus
ops.description: Shows only one group, or every group again.

ops.name: view.mode
ops.description: Shows sessions in groups or as one list.

ops.name: view.sort
ops.description: Sets the sort key and direction.

ops.name: wake.set
ops.description: Turns waking the Mac for jobs on or off, checking the sudoers rule again.

ops.name: watch
ops.description: Waits until something changes, or a timeout passes. A view's heartbeat while it's open.
